name: diary-week-fdw1
description: Согласованность недели календаря «Дневника» при first_day_of_week=1: подписи столбцов, заголовок строки недели, клик по строке недели, клик по дню и предопределённый набор «Мои записи за неделю». Запуск: node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.diary-week-fdw1.scenario.json --out .tmp/etn-73fa3c3b/fdw1

steps.name: seed-week
steps.eval: (async () => { const nid = '{{networkId}}'; const seed = '{{thoughtId}}'; const mk = async (title, day) => { const t = new Date(day + 'T12:00:00').toISOString(); return window.etn.comments.create(nid, 'thought', seed, { kind: 'chronological', title, body_md: 'запись ' + day, valid_from: t, valid_to: t }); }; for (const d of ['2026-10-12','2026-10-13','2026-10-14','2026-10-15','2026-10-16','2026-10-17','2026-10-18']) { await mk('Д ' + d, d); } return true; })()

steps.name: click-week-row-1012
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.chron-cal .cal-week')).find((e) => (e.getAttribute('title') || '').includes('2026-10-12')); if (!b) throw new Error('нет строки недели 2026-10-12'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()

steps.name: week-row-state
steps.probe: ({ days: document.querySelectorAll('.diary-day').length, dayKeys: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.diary-day')).map((e) => e.dataset.day), selected: document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-selected').length, selectedDays: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-selected')).map((e) => e.getAttribute('title')), from: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="from"] select')?.value ?? null, to: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="to"] select')?.value ?? null })

steps.name: click-day-1014
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.chron-cal .cal-day')).find((e) => e.getAttribute('title') === '2026-10-14'); if (!b) throw new Error('нет дня 2026-10-14'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()

steps.name: day-state
steps.probe: ({ days: document.querySelectorAll('.diary-day').length, selected: document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-selected').length, from: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="from"] select')?.value ?? null, shift: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="from"] .fv-date__shift')?.value ?? null })

steps.name: open-saved
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .ff-extra--saved'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()
